description.zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: Application ID. Create and query through the console. Only a single ID is supported.

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit

This API supports up to 10 calls per second per user. If you exceed this limit, rate limiting is triggered, which might affect your service. Call the API at a reasonable frequency.
